name: unikit-archive
description: Archive finished plans and code researches. Moves a finished folder plan from .unikit/code/plans/<folder>/ to .unikit/code/archive/plans/<folder>/ and a research from .unikit/code/researches/<slug>/ to .unikit/code/archive/researches/<slug>/, so plan lookup, the plan lists and /unikit-plan stop offering them. Asks first whether to archive plans, researches or both. A plan that links a research still finds it by its folder name; a research linked by an unfinished plan is not offered; restore brings one back. An unfinished plan moves only when the user picks it, and is marked as unfinished. Items are picked by number or by date. Never deletes, renames or commits. Use when user says "archive plans", "archive researches", "clean up researches", "archive completed", "clean up plans", "restore a research", or "show archived plans". Not for .unikit/code/PLAN.md, FIX_PLAN.md or game-design researches; to check that a plan is really done use /unikit-verify, to commit the move use /unikit-commit.
